dimensions.label: Liquidité
dimensions.note: Ratio de liquidité générale (current ratio). NC 01 recommends ≥1. Threshold ≥1.5 is standard practice for manufacturing; ≥1.0 is the minimum solvency floor.

dimensions.label: Endettement
dimensions.note: Taux d'endettement global: dettes financières (PNC+PC) rapportées au total passif. Range 0–1. Definition chosen: dettes/total_passif (not D/E) to avoid division by negative equity. Judgment call: ≤0.50 = maîtrisé, 0.50–0.70 = modéré, >0.70 = élevé.

dimensions.label: Autonomie financière
dimensions.note: Ratio d'autonomie financière (equity ratio). Judgment call: ≥0.40 considered strong per Tunisian SME practice. Negative equity is a distress signal and overrides band matching.

dimensions.label: Profitabilité
dimensions.note: Marge nette. Requires has_cr=true. Do NOT conflate with growth. Judgment call: ≥0.10 = bonne, 0.05–0.10 = correcte, <0.05 (including negative) = faible.
